title: Environmental Epigenetics 2026 Update
content: The Oxford University Press publication Environmental Epigenetics, just initiated its twelfth year of operations with this Volume 12 Issue 1. We are a 100% Open Access journal listed in PubMed Central (PMC), along with numerous other access sites. Environmental Epigenetics publishes scientific and medical research related to the field of epigenetics with particular interest on the impact of the environment. Special Issues have occurred each year and we encourage requests for Special Issues in environmental epigenetics. Our Special Issues in 2022–2025 were on Epigenetic Transgenerational Inheritance, Environmental Epigenetics and Evolutionary Biology, and Environmental Epigenetics and Climate Change (https://academic.oup.com/eep/pages/special_issues). The Special Issues for 2026 include Environmental Epigenetics and Disease, and Epigenetic Transgenerational Inheritance. The amount and diversity of our published studies is increasing as the field of environmental epigenetics grows and expands. We are looking forward to another productive year and encourage you to consider submissions to Environmental Epigenetics.
